answer_1.quote: generating hypotheses with GPT-4o (Ope-nAI, 2024) using customized prompts to ensure label diversity and balance and manually reviewing hypotheses and annotated explanations.

answer_2.quote: Explanation quality is assessed using BLEU (1-4), ROUGE-1/2/L, and METEOR.

answer_4.quote: All human annotation was conducted on the original English versions of the premises and hypotheses.
answer_4.guideline: Minimal Sufficiency: Annotators should select the minimal set of EDUs that are necessary and sufficient to support the inference conclusion... Cross-document Coverage: Selected EDUs must include evidence from both premise documents... Logical Completeness: The selected EDUs should form a complete logical chain...
